name: xmlattributes-test-067a6f32b7/xmlattributes-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions > Variable reference: Currently `xml-qualified-names` not supported
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.string lists indexOf, includes, substring and trim but not lastIndexOf
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: `string:indexOf`, `string:includes`, `string:substring` and `string:equalsIgnoreCaseAscii`
Expressions > XML template expression: Supports interpolation in XML content and attributes
reason: Essential QName expression uses such as xAttr[ns0:foo1] and string s1 = ns0:wso2 hit the explicit xml-qualified-names restriction. Independently, the invoked serialization assertion helper calls string.lastIndexOf, which is absent from both the permitted string langlib functions and method-call list. Supported XML templates and getAttributes do not remove these restrictions.
unsupported_constructs: XML-qualified-name expressions used as attribute map keys and string values
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: supported XML attribute operations and interpolation are combined with unsupported QName expressions and lastIndexOf.

Output markers assert exact namespace prefix selection and serialized declaration/attribute order, plus namespace entries in attribute-map length/keys; these are behavioral assertions beyond return signatures.
No @args or @panic markers; internal panic assertions check character-reference preservation and empty-sequence attribute errors. No obvious marker mismatch.
